originality.rationale: The exact all-order crown-preorder SUPPORT enumerator and its Chebyshev simple-negative-root classification were not found in published-finding corpus, the available own ledger or the inspected primary literature. The gamma matchable-pairs theorem and cycle matching polynomial are expressly prior ingredients. The degree-2m-2 crown order-polytope Ehrhart numerator is not the degree-2m support polynomial. A detailed November 2026 crown-free flag-sphere theorem summary excludes crowns, and does not state the asserted crown root classification. Priority remains provisional because searches and source access are bounded.
residual_risks: The underlying full manuscript of the most closely related November 15, 2026 candidate release was not directly read; only its detailed and explicit specialist summary was accessible.
Bounded searchable sources and published-finding corpus records cannot establish global historical uniqueness; an equivalent earlier cycle/interior-polynomial specialization may be unindexed.
Crown m=3 is isomorphic to the previously studied three-element-per-level standard example; this does not extend to the all-order claim.
An exact all-order crown specialization is not ruled out by negative searches; the cycle matching polynomial and Chebyshev theory themselves are classical.

value.rationale: The natural infinite crown family lies exactly outside a new crown-free flag-realization theorem; a complete support enumerator and all-order simple-negative root geometry answer a meaningful family-level piece of the preorder support real-rootedness program. Exact all-order coefficients and root locations, with a structural explanation for the top matching correction, are not routine parameter renaming or a fixed-size table. The result does not claim a general new gamma-positivity theorem.
